description: This file defines the `TalkModeManager` class, a central component managing speech recognition, speech synthesis, and interaction with a chat gateway for a voice-related application. It handles microphone input, speech recognition sessions, PTT (Push-To-Talk), chat interactions, and TTS (Text-to-Speech) playback, including incremental speech handling and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper for storing and setting stream failure errors.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: The main class managing voice interaction modes, including speech recognition, synthesis, chat interaction, and related state management.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Attaches a GatewayNodeSession instance to the manager for communication.

methods.name: updateGatewayConnected
methods.description: Updates the connection state to the gateway and triggers recognition start if applicable.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the current session key used for chat interactions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the entire talk mode system.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts speech recognition and chat session, requesting permissions as needed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition, chat, and speech synthesis, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: suspendForBackground
methods.description: Temporarily suspends microphone usage without fully disabling talk mode.

methods.name: resumeAfterBackground
methods.description: Resumes speech recognition after returning from background state.

methods.name: userTappedOrb
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech output, typically triggered by user interaction.

methods.name: endPushToTalk

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce

methods.name: cancelPushToTalk

methods.name: startRecognition

methods.name: restartRecognitionAfterError

methods.name: makeAudioTapAppendCallback

methods.name: handleTranscript

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence has persisted long enough to process the transcript.

methods.name: schedulePTTTimeout

methods.name: finishPTTOnce
